en_US.title: Aegir Primary Light and Radiation
en_US.scanner: Stellar note. Warm K-dwarf light, not deep-space darkness, sets the system baseline.

en_US.audio: It is not black out here. That is the problem. There is enough light to work, and enough radiation to charge you for every mistake.

en_US.field_note: System overview record: Aegir's readable sky comes from warm dwarf light, while radiation and magnetosphere windows keep travel expensive.
